name: calm-mode
description: Calm Mode for Claude Code: a friendly checklist instead of tool calls; Calm Recap: a Welcome back card and a prompt-cache meter on their own; Calm Aside: a read-only side chat about the session; Calm Enhance: an Enhance button that turns a short draft into a precise prompt. Also lists three of Ray Amjad's mods (decision-tree, diagram-pane, secret-box), pulled from his repo so they keep his updates.
